findings.summary: Spec §2 criterion 2 (⭐⭐ discriminative GT-17) is entirely untested: no test constructs a generate/worker run that has exited without producing a result and asserts that the tick still exits 0, other decisions proceed, and the diagnostic appears in output. No reverse test verifies that reverting to non-zero-exit makes the test red. No reverse case verifies that a truly-unrecoverable error (bus unreachable) still non-zero exits. The generateError field and GenerateWorkerExitedWithoutResultError are never exercised by any test in test/.

Spec §2 criterion 3 (⭐ discriminative GT-14/§1.2) is entirely untested: no test publishes an agent.run.exited.v1 message and asserts that checkRunExited short-circuits the result-wait loop immediately (instead of waiting for the full AGENT_RESULT_TIMEOUT_MS deadline). The existing g6 R2a/R2c tests only exercise the deadline-timeout path (fetch returns empty forever), never the exited-without-result short-circuit path. checkRunExited, TriageWorkerExitedWithoutResultError, and the triage skippedReason field are never asserted on.

Spec §2 criterion 2b (⭐ discriminative GT-15/GT-16) is untested: no test drives a real --run on a seed board (1 clue) and asserts completion under half the engine node_timeout with a readable termination. workflow.yaml still shows node_timeout:30 with no test proving a seed-board tick stays well under it.
